In this activity, we will go through a problem which demonstrates how the projection operator can be used to give a quantitative estimate to measure how good a straight line is, for modeling given data points. Let us consider two quantities $x$ and $y$, whose dependence on each other we would like to understand. To do so, we perform experiments and observe finitely many data points. We would like to determine the straight line passing through the origin that best models the given data.  
  
(Note that a straight line may not be the best curve to model the given data.This activity only focuses on finding the best model among straight lines passing through the origin.)  
  
Consider the following data comprising tuples $(x, y)$.  
  
$v\_1$ = (−2, −2), $v\_2$ = (−1, −1), $v\_3$ = (0, 1), $v\_4$ = (3, 2).  
  
Answer the following questions to formulate the function that needs to be optimized in order to find the ‘best straight line passing through the origin’ to model the given data. In all the questions that follow, $l\_m$ will be used to denote the straight line in $\\mathbb{R}^2$ of slope m that passes through the origin. $P\_W (v)$ will be used to denote the projection of the vector $v$ on to the subspace $W$.

JavaScript should be enabled to grade this question.

There is no single line which contains all of the given points. If $l\_m$ is chosen as a model for the given data, we measure the error contributed by the point $v\_i$ for this model using the square of the distance between $v\_i$ and the point on $l\_m$ that is nearest to $v\_i$ . _1 point_

The error function corresponding to a given line is defined as the sum of the errors contributed by each point. Which of the following is the correct formula for the error function for the given points modeled using the line $l\_m$?

$\\sum\_{i=1}^4 ||v\_i||^2$

$\\sum\_{i=1}^4 ||P\_{l\_{m}}(v\_i)||^2$

$\\sum\_{i=1}^4 ||v\_i + P\_{l\_{m}}(v\_i)||^2$

$\\sum\_{i=1}^4 ||v\_i - P\_{l\_{m}}(v\_i)||^2$

### Yes, the answer is correct.  
Score: 1

### Accepted Answers:

$\\sum\_{i=1}^4 ||v\_i - P\_{l\_{m}}(v\_i)||^2$

  
  
Techniques from calculus can be used to find the minimum of the above function. This gives the value of the slope for which the error is minimum. This line is called the line of best fit. You are encouraged to find the line of best fit for the above problem.
